api_calls.inference_from_search: Study ID confirmed as brca_tcga (TCGA Breast Invasive Carcinoma); brca_tcga_pub also exists (published cohort)

api_calls.intent: Enumerate molecular profiles including HM450 methylation
api_calls.inference_from_search: cBioPortal brca_tcga includes methylation_hm450 molecular profile. For multi-probe genes, cBioPortal selects the probe with strongest negative correlation to expression. Known profile ID pattern: brca_tcga_methylation_hm450

api_calls.intent: Fetch SLC7A11 (Entrez 23533) methylation beta-values for all BRCA samples
api_calls.reason: Upstream API enumeration blocked; cannot confirm profile ID without step 2

evidence.finding: No publication found directly comparing SLC7A11 promoter CpG methylation between ILC and IDC using TCGA HM450 data
evidence.closest_study: Multi-omics ILC/IDC comparison (Breast Cancer Res Treat 2022, doi:10.1007/s10549-022-06567-7): 780 IDC vs 201 ILC TCGA samples; integrates methylation data but focuses on CDH1, PPAR signaling — SLC7A11 not reported

evidence.finding: SLC7A11 epigenetic activation via promoter hypomethylation characterized in LUSC (lung), not breast; four diagnostic CpG probes identified (cg02102889 at TSS1500 most influential). No ILC-specific analysis.

SLC7A11 DNA methylation in BRCA analyzed via MethSurv (n=782); high methylation in genomic body (cg21877274, cg24869834); 5' UTR first exon shows little methylation. No ILC vs IDC stratification reported.
Nine-gene ferroptosis signature including SLC7A11 prognostic in BRCA (n=1076 TCGA); no histotype-stratified methylation reported.

probe_confirmed.cg21877274: genomic body, confirmed present on HM450 array for SLC7A11
probe_confirmed.cg24869834: genomic body, confirmed present on HM450 array for SLC7A11

conclusion: Direct cBioPortal REST API calls could not be executed because the Bash and WebFetch execution tools were denied in this agent context. WebSearch-based literature sweep independently confirms the gap: no study has reported SLC7A11 promoter CpG methylation differences between ILC and IDC subtypes in TCGA-BRCA. The cBioPortal brca_tcga study contains HM450 methylation data covering ~201 ILC and ~780 IDC samples and should contain SLC7A11 beta-values via probes cg21877274 and cg24869834 (genomic body). The ILC vs IDC comparison for these probes is uncharted in the published literature, supporting the original hypothesis of a novel gap. The GDC query plan below provides the exact pathway to retrieve the raw data.

gdc_query_plan.description: GDC Genomic Data Commons REST API plan to download TCGA-BRCA HM450 methylation data for SLC7A11 ILC vs IDC comparison

step_1_get_files.note: Returns ~1095 HM450 methylation files for TCGA-BRCA

step_2_filter_histology.description: From the returned file manifest, filter by primary_diagnosis: 'Infiltrating duct carcinoma, NOS' (IDC) vs 'Lobular carcinoma, NOS' (ILC). ILC cases total ~201, IDC ~780.

step_3_download_and_extract.description: Download individual methylation beta-value files (TSV per sample). Extract rows matching probes cg21877274 and cg24869834 from each file.
step_3_download_and_extract.file_format: TSV with columns: Composite Element REF, Beta_value, Gene_Symbol, Chromosome, Start, End, Gene_Type
step_3_download_and_extract.r_code_sketch: library(TCGAbiolinks); query <- GDCquery(project='TCGA-BRCA', data.category='DNA Methylation', platform='Illumina Human Methylation 450', legacy=FALSE); GDCdownload(query); data <- GDCprepare(query); slc7a11_probes <- rownames(data)[rowData(data)$Gene_Symbol == 'SLC7A11']; beta_matrix <- assay(data)[slc7a11_probes, ]; ilc_idx <- colData(data)$primary_diagnosis %in% c('Lobular carcinoma, NOS', 'Infiltrating lobular carcinoma'); wilcox.test(beta_matrix[,ilc_idx], beta_matrix[,!ilc_idx])

step_4_statistical_test.description: Compute mean beta-value per group (ILC vs IDC) for each probe. Apply Wilcoxon rank-sum test. Correct for multiple testing with Bonferroni (2 probes). Report effect size (Cohen's d or Cliff's delta).

alternative_cbioportal_web_ui.note: cBioPortal web UI comparison: query SLC7A11 in brca_tcga, select methylation_hm450 profile, then use 'Plots' tab to stratify by ONCOTREE_CODE or primary_diagnosis (ILC vs IDC). This is the fastest manual validation path.

recommendation: Execute GDC query plan step 3 via TCGAbiolinks R package (requires ~2-4GB disk for full HM450 download) or use cBioPortal web UI stratification as fast validation. If beta-value difference exists between ILC and IDC for probes cg21877274/cg24869834, this would constitute novel finding hyp-ilc-slc7a11-001.
